question: What is most likely to break first?

options.label: Prompt injection or data exfiltration
options.description: The agent reads untrusted input and has access to sensitive data or external tools

options.label: Context bloat, cache misses, or runaway token spend
options.description: Long sessions, big tool catalogs, or multi-step tool outputs overwhelm the context window or budget

options.label: Silent failures, hallucinations, or flaky outputs
options.description: The agent appears to work until it quietly breaks, loops, or regresses after a prompt or model change

options.label: Multi-agent conflicts, starvation, or coordination drift
options.description: Parallel agents overwrite each other's work, drop handoffs, or starve lower-priority tasks

options.label: Long-running session drift or lost state
options.description: Multi-hour or asynchronous jobs lose track of goals, progress, or credentials mid-run

options.label: Unverified code or UI changes reaching users
options.description: Generated code compiles or passes unit tests but ships broken UX, security bugs, or spec drift

question: What is the agent's trust boundary?

options.label: Trusted inputs, read-only or easily reversible actions
options.description: Low blast radius; mistakes are cheap to undo

options.label: Reads untrusted external content
options.description: Processes web pages, emails, tickets, PRs, or third-party documents that may carry prompt injections

options.label: Takes irreversible or high-consequence external actions
options.description: Modifies production databases, pushes code, sends messages, spends money, or changes permissions

options.label: Interactive single-agent session
options.description: A user works directly with one agent across turns

options.label: Long-running or scheduled autonomous worker
options.description: Runs unattended over hours/days, on schedules, or in CI

options.label: Parallel sub-agents or multi-agent fleet
options.description: Fans out work across concurrent workers or specialized agents

options.label: Software engineering & DevOps
options.description: Writing, reviewing, testing, refactoring, or migrating code

options.label: Enterprise workflows & API/tool automation
options.description: Connecting internal systems, tickets, databases, approvals, and SaaS APIs

options.label: Deep research, RAG & synthesis
options.description: Multi-round search, large-document extraction, and cited reporting

options.label: Browser automation & frontend UI
options.description: Interacting with web pages, DOMs, or verifying rendered user interfaces
